name: ironwork
description: Read your strength training from Ironwork and draft programs you review in the app.

capabilities: Draft programs, routines and exercises for review
defaultPrompt: How did my bench press go this month?
Weekly sets per muscle over the last 8 weeks: what is undertrained?
How do I log a drop set in Ironwork?

positive.prompt: How did my bench press go over the last 8 weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: Names Barbell Bench Press, gives the top sets by week, the e1RM change over the range and the latest record with its date.

positive.prompt: Weekly sets per muscle over the last 8 weeks. What is undertrained?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists weekly working sets per muscle and names the muscles with the fewest sets.

positive.prompt: Which of my main lifts has stalled?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the main lifts with their weekly best e1RM and names the Romanian deadlift as flat over the last weeks.

positive.prompt: How do I log a drop set in Ironwork?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the steps from the Log a drop set article with the app's labels and its link; reads no training data.

positive.prompt: Draft a 3-day full-body program for strength, 60 minutes a session, barbell and dumbbells.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a draft program, reports the method check's findings, and says it is in Ironwork under Training, marked From ChatGPT, to review and save.

negative.description: General nutrition question unrelated to the lifter's log
Logging a workout, which no tool can do
negative.prompt: Log a 5 km run for me this morning.

negative.description: A feature Ironwork does not have; must not be invented
negative.prompt: How do I sync my Garmin watch with Ironwork?

publication.release_notes: First release: ask ChatGPT about your Ironwork training, and draft programs, routines and exercises you review and save in the app.
